items.c: This March we walk with Jesus through his last week, from the table to the empty tomb. Alive Again starts Sunday, March 7. #AliveAgain
This Sunday: The Table, from Luke 22:14–23. Worship is at 10:30. Save us a seat. #AliveAgain
"Do this in remembrance of me." (Luke 22:19) #AliveAgain
Tell us in the comments: whose table do you remember most growing up? #AliveAgain
This Sunday we’ll share the Lord’s Supper together. All who trust in Jesus are welcome at the table. #AliveAgain
Sunday at Harvest Hill: groups at 9:15 and worship at 10:30. Bring a friend. #AliveAgain
Missed Sunday? "The Table" from Luke 22:14–23 is up at harvesthill.church. Watch it this week and pass it on. #AliveAgain
This Sunday: The Garden, from Luke 22:39–46. Worship is at 10:30. Save us a seat. #AliveAgain
“Jesus didn't send a memo.” 🎬 Full message on YouTube. #AliveAgain
"Not my will, but yours, be done." (Luke 22:42) #AliveAgain
What are you praying through right now? Reply and our prayer team will pray with you this week. #AliveAgain
Prayer night is tonight at 7:00 in the chapel. Come for ten minutes or the whole hour. #AliveAgain
Sunday at Harvest Hill: groups at 9:15 and worship at 10:30. Bring a friend. #AliveAgain
Missed Sunday? "The Garden" from Luke 22:39–46 is up at harvesthill.church. Watch it this week and pass it on. #AliveAgain
Easter invite cards are at the welcome table. Grab a few for neighbors, coworkers and friends. #AliveAgain
This Sunday: The King Comes, from Luke 19:28–40. Worship is at 10:30. Save us a seat. #AliveAgain
“Gethsemane shows us that honest prayer and trusting prayer are the same prayer.” 🎬 Full message on YouTube. #AliveAgain
"Blessed is the King who comes in the name of the Lord!" (Luke 19:38) #AliveAgain
Holy Week at Harvest Hill: Palm Sunday, Maundy Thursday, Good Friday and Easter Sunday. All are welcome. #AliveAgain
Easter is nine days away. Who is one person you could invite? Pray for them by name this week. #AliveAgain
Sunday at Harvest Hill: groups at 9:15 and worship at 10:30. Bring a friend. #AliveAgain
Missed Sunday? "The King Comes" from Luke 19:28–40 is up at harvesthill.church. Watch it this week and pass it on. #AliveAgain
Easter Sunday, March 28: sunrise service at 7:00, breakfast at 9:00 and worship at 10:30 with an egg hunt for kids. #AliveAgain
“The crowd wanted a king who would fix Rome.” 🎬 Full message on YouTube. #AliveAgain
"With his wounds we are healed." (Isaiah 53:5) #AliveAgain
Tonight at 7:00 we gather around the table on the night Jesus washed his disciples’ feet. #AliveAgain
Good Friday service tonight at 7:00. A quiet hour of Scripture, song and silence. #AliveAgain
Tomorrow is Easter! Sunrise at 7:00, breakfast at 9:00, worship at 10:30. Come early, bring a friend. #AliveAgain
He is not here, for he has risen. Happy Easter from all of us at Harvest Hill! #AliveAgain
What a Sunday. Thank you to every volunteer, greeter and guest. If you were here for the first time, we’d love to meet you. #AliveAgain
Ready for a next step? Baptism class is Sunday, April 11 after worship. Sign up at harvesthill.church. #AliveAgain
“The stone wasn't rolled away to let Jesus out.” 🎬 Full message on YouTube. #AliveAgain
"But in fact Christ has been raised from the dead." (1 Corinthians 15:20) #AliveAgain
